body:
Refresh every active dependency against live registries after Dependabot PR #32, migrate the scanner to native ESM/TypeScript configuration loading, and keep SDK updates covered automatically.

Fixes #33

- Upgrade rc-config-loader 4.1.4 → 5.0.0 with a regenerated npm lock. Use Node's native module/type loading and remove the old upstream loader path. Raise the npm engine floor to the selected 12.2.2 CLI.
- Advance the vcpkg baseline to current registry head `4702e381`, including vcpkg-tool 2026-10-29. Exclude older monthly tags that Dependabot would otherwise propose as downgrades.
- Add Dependabot `dotnet-sdk` coverage for `global.json`; there are no managed projects or NuGet dependency manifests requiring a separate NuGet entry.
- Re-query all 60 Python packages, 76 scanner npm packages, Actions, hooks, SDKs, native tools and image digest. Already-current pins remain unchanged. Regenerate Python resolutions and add a patch changelog fragment.

The [complete evidence and requirement inventory](https://github.com/link-foundation/cpp-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/blob/issue-33-2c3d53a97d9f/dev/log/issues/33/pulls/34/PLAN.md), [before/final/latest tables](https://github.com/link-foundation/cpp-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/blob/issue-33-2c3d53a97d9f/dev/log/issues/33/pulls/34/DEPENDENCIES.md), [analysis and alternatives](https://github.com/link-foundation/cpp-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/blob/issue-33-2c3d53a97d9f/dev/log/issues/33/pulls/34/ANALYSIS.md), [upstream reports](https://github.com/link-foundation/cpp-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/blob/issue-33-2c3d53a97d9f/dev/log/issues/33/pulls/34/UPSTREAM.md) and [validation](https://github.com/link-foundation/cpp-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/blob/issue-33-2c3d53a97d9f/dev/log/issues/33/pulls/34/VALIDATION.md) are committed in `dev/log/issues/33/pulls/34`.

Validation: 509 script tests and all pre-commit hooks pass. The 20 scanner tests and repository scan pass; strict Python and project npm audits have zero findings. The new ESM/TypeScript regression cases fail with the old loader (18 pass / 2 fail) and pass with v5. Explicit CJS configuration remains covered; v5's discovery changes are documented. Full native builds, lint, sanitizers, consumers, documentation and packaging run in CI.

New upstream reports: [Dependabot vcpkg ancestry check](https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/issues/16938) and [Secretlint rc-config-loader 5 support](https://github.com/secretlint/secretlint/issues/1836). Twenty earlier reports were rechecked; necessary workarounds remain covered and linked in the upstream report table.

Unfinished external criteria:

- Main Security fails because `CONAN_AUDIT_PROVIDER_TOKEN_CONANCENTER` is absent, as it did before PR #32. Full logs identify the failure at line 5050. Configure the free registered Conan Audit token, then rerun Security. PRs retain an explicit incomplete native-audit warning; main/scheduled/manual runs still fail with setup instructions. The gate has not been weakened, and a passing PR does not certify native advisory coverage.
- The current published npm 12.2.2 CLI bundle still has 21 moderate audit entries from glob/minimatch advisories ([npm/cli#10299](https://github.com/npm/cli/issues/10299)). Project overrides cannot replace CLI-bundled packages. The separate CLI audit and every bundled version are recorded.
- Conan Center CMake, clang-tidy wheels and hosted compiler distributions still lag upstream releases. Every exception and existing upstream report is recorded in the dependency tables.

These criteria remain unfinished; this PR is not a claim that main is green or that every upstream distribution is advisory-free. Leave the PR unmerged pending their resolution.
title: Refresh dependencies, native tooling and SDK update coverage
